description: Nose section at a private house within sight of Kadena Gate 4; sold off after withdrawal and acquired by Okinawa Ordnance who displayed it at their shopfront before it came here

Forward fuselage beside the neighbouring building now occupied by the Patisserie Rouge cake shop; the three-digit nose number has been erased but the fuselage technical block survives; visible in the shop's 2018 Street View imagery
